entities.name: Rosendo Álvarez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rosendo José Álvarez Hernández is a Nicaraguan former professional boxer who competed from 1992 to 2012. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the World Boxing Association (WBA) mini-flyweight title from 1995 to 1998, the WBA light-flyweight title from 2001 to 2004, and the inaugural Ring magazine light-flyweight title from 2003 to 2004.
